sn2.6:1.1: Ekam antaṃ ṭhito kho Kāmado devaputto Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Dukkaram Bhagavā sudukkaraṃ Bhagavāti || ||
sn2.6:2.1: Dukkaram vā pi karonti || (Kāmadā ti Bhagavā) || sekhasīlasamāhitā ṭhitattā || anagāriyupetassa || tuṭṭhi hoti sukhāvahā ti || ||
sn2.6:4.1: Dullabhaṃ vā pi labhanti || (Kāmadāti Bhagavā) cittavūpasame ratā || yesaṃ divā ca ratto ca || bhāvanāya rato mano ti || ||
sn2.6:5.1: Dussamādahaṃ Bhagavā yad idaṃ cittan ti || ||
sn2.6:6.1: Dussamādahaṃ vāpi samādahanti || (Kāmadāti Bhagavā) || indriyūpasame ratā || te chetvā maccuno jālaṃ || ariyā gacchanti Kāmadāti || ||
sn2.6:8.1: Duggame visame vā pi || ariyā gacchanti Kāmada || anariyā visame magge || papatanti avaṃsirā || ariyānaṃ samo maggo || ariyā hi visame samā ti || ||
